messages:
maya: Quick summary from today
- ran stress benches on marabou12b (int4) vs int8 on 48GB canaries
- int4: median latency 85ms, cost ~0.62x int8, but higher kv_frag_ratio under mixed sessions
- observed alloc failures at heavy tails (~>3k tokens)

tess: thanks. primary ask: how do we keep int4 cost wins without the OOM tail?

maya: experiments: 1) increase slot-compactor freq 30m->10m reduced frag ~0.12; 2) prewarm 1GiB slab on load reduces early spikes; 3) routing heavy sessions to int8 eliminates alloc failures but ups cost ~18% for those sessions

omar: plan: keep int4 default, implement routing heuristic for heavy sessions -> int8 variant. also add token-throttle guard at runtime for combined tokens >2500 to reject with 413 hint.

jia: PR for route detector and throttle is up (#12411). adds metrics kv_slots_free, alloc_fail_rate, frag_ratio_10s. ETA review 6h.

kai: feature flag created: marabou.quant_fallback. rollout: 5% canary -> 25% -> 50% if stable. abort on >2 OOMs per host in 30m or frag_ratio jump >0.1.

infra-bot: Canary cohort created: marabou.quant_fallback -> 5% (canary-48gb). Monitoring window 1h.

tess: action items: maya -> nightly eval harness for int4 vs int8 (quality diffs), jia -> land PR and token throttle, kai -> enable compactor every 10m on canaries, omar -> run defrag sweep on canary hosts.

maya: provisional docs note: customers can opt-out by pinning marabou12b-int4 explicitly. add alert for kv_frag_ratio>0.7 -> page oncall.

infra-bot: Metric alert created: marabou12b.kv_frag_ratio > 0.7 for 2m -> page oncall.

tess: thanks team. keep an eye on long-tail workloads and add mixed-length perf-eval to regression suite. :thumbsup:
